integrity.claim_type: analytic theorem with executable finite-state checks

scientific_limitations: Only equal-rate continuous-time simple random walkers on an unweighted finite star are considered.
All conclusions concern hub-class projections, not unique full labelled stationary laws at degenerate population sizes.
The full labelled chain may be reducible when k=n-1.
Exact all-parameter proof is analytic; finite enumeration is diagnostic only.
Historical priority beyond inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: Poisson hub switching and three distinct survival ensembles for many walkers on a star
